description: This file defines the Statistics model class within the Opencart system, responsible for interacting with the 'statistics' database table. It provides methods to retrieve, add, remove, and edit statistical data records.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: A model class for managing statistical data in the Opencart system, including methods for retrieving and updating statistics stored in the database.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all records from the statistics table in the database.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific statistical code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the value of a specific statistical code by a given amount.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the value of a specific statistical code by a specified amount.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific statistical code to a new value.
